compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Operator report: rebar sends sampling parameters that newer models reject, so plan review fails with a 400 on those models. rebar decides per model whether to send `temperature` from `ModelCapabilities.supports_temperature` (`src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:85`), which **defaults to True**; only exact ids listed in `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` (`capabilities.py:230-275`: Opus 4.7/4.8 and the 5.5 family under the `""`, `us.anthropic.`, `global.anthropic.` prefixes) withhold it. `structured_run.build_model_settings` (`structured_run.py:400-404`) sends `temperature` whenever one is configured and the capability is True. Temperature is configured on every verifier path: the completion verifier pins `temperature=0.0` (`completion.py:396-397`), plan-review floors pin it (`plan_review/floors.py:90,264`), and workflow steps carry `temperature: 0` (`workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml:210,316`, `code-review.yaml:184`, applied by `workflow/runs.py:223-225`). rebar never sends `top_p`/`top_k` (no config surface reaches `model_settings`).

## Observation

Measured 2026-11-11 on Bedrock Converse, us-west-2 (`AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock`), maxTokens 16, the report's table holds for every id probed:
- `us.anthropic.claude-{opus-4-7,opus-5,sonnet-5,sonnet-5-5,opus-5-5,haiku-5-5}`: bare accepted; `temperature=0` rejected "`temperature` is deprecated for this model."; `temperature=1.0` accepted; `topP=0.9` rejected "`top_p` is deprecated for this model."
- `us.openai.gpt-5.5`, `us.openai.gpt-6.1-sol`, `us.moonshotai.kimi-k3.1`: bare accepted; temperature 0 and 1.0 rejected "This model doesn't support the temperature field. Remove temperature and try again."; topP rejected "This model doesn't support the topP field. Remove topP and try again."
- Accept everything: `us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1`, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6`, `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0`, `us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-5-20251101-v1:0`, `us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0`, `us.meta.llama4-maverick-17b-instruct-v1:0`, `us.mistral.pixtral-large-2502-v1:0`, `us.deepseek.r1-v1:0`.

What origin/main b878c4be768 hands boto3 `converse` through `PydanticAIRunner.run()` with `temperature=0.0` (scratch repro, intercepting Bedrock client): `inferenceConfig` contains `temperature: 0.0` for `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5`, `global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5`, `anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`, `eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`, `apac.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`, `us.openai.gpt-5.5`, `us.openai.gpt-6.1-sol`, `us.moonshotai.kimi-k3.1`; it is absent only for the listed `us.`/`global.` 5.5 and 4.7/4.8 ids. So `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` (the configured standard class, `rebar.toml:225`) already works on main (change 3340); every unlisted rejecting id still 400s.

Second defect: `failure.translate_sampling_parameter_rejection` (`failure.py:435-476`) requires a rejection word in `("deprecated","not supported","unsupported")` and a param name in `("temperature","top_p","top_k")`. The OpenAI/Kimi wording ("doesn't support", "topP") matches neither, so those 400s fall through to the generic `LLMUnavailableError` (verified: a `ModelHTTPError(400)` with the OpenAI body returns None).

## Hypotheses

Root cause: sampling is opt-out (default True plus a deny-list), so every model not yet measured is presumed to accept; the deny-list cannot keep up with new ids, prefixes (`anthropic.`, `eu.`, `apac.`) and vendors. The translator's phrase list was written from the Claude wording only.

## Approach

Unconditional behaviour; no new config key, env var or feature flag.
1. Opt-in sampling: `ModelCapabilities.supports_temperature` defaults False; a new exact-id `_SAMPLING_ACCEPTING_MODEL_IDS` frozenset in `capabilities.py` (set membership, per the no-prefix-matching guard in `tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py:115`) lists only the measured-accepting ids above under their `""`/`us.`/`global.` profiles plus direct-Anthropic `claude-opus-4-6`, `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-haiku-4-5[-20251001]`, `claude-opus-4-5`. Both the profile path and the string fallback path of `capabilities_for` use it. Every other model, including any future Claude ≥4.7 id, gets no `temperature`. The now-redundant `supports_temperature: False` rows are removed; the 5.5 effort rows stay. Verifier pins stay as the requested value and are withheld by the capability.
2. Translator matches both message forms (`doesn't support`/`does not support`; `topP`/`topK`) and names the opt-in remedy.
3. One-shot retry: when a run that sent a sampling parameter fails with a matching 400, `runner.run()` records the resolved model in a module-level set in `runner_support.py`, logs one WARNING, and re-runs once; capabilities for a recorded model have `supports_temperature` cleared for the process lifetime. A second matching failure raises the existing `LLMConfigError`. No lock/env/config (nothing the mechanism ratchet counts). `run()` stays ≤ its complexity ceiling 24 by extracting the withheld-temperature log block into a helper.
4. Docs: `docs/llm-framework.md:328-332` describes opt-in.

Out of scope (filed as separate tickets): operator-declared capabilities in config, a provider-neutral reasoning-effort surface, a pre-release model-list probe.

## Scope

`src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py`, `src/rebar/llm/failure.py`, `src/rebar/llm/runner.py`, `src/rebar/llm/runner_support.py`, `src/rebar/llm/completion.py` (comment), `docs/llm-framework.md`, new `tests/unit/test_sampling_opt_in.py`, and updated expectations in `tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py`, `tests/unit/test_llm_capabilities.py`.

## Testing

`tests/unit/test_sampling_opt_in.py` drives `PydanticAIRunner.run()` with `temperature=0.0` through the real `BedrockConverseModel` with an intercepting boto client (pattern: `tests/unit/test_agentic_message_cache.py:186-212`): every rejecting id above (plus `anthropic.`/`eu.`/`apac.` 5.5 and an unknown `us.anthropic.claude-opus-6`) yields no `temperature`/`topP` in `inferenceConfig`; each accepting id still sends `temperature: 0.0`. Failure path: a client whose first `converse` raises a `ClientError` ValidationException with each message form, then succeeds, yields one retry whose request has no `temperature`, and a later run for the same model sends none; a client that rejects twice surfaces `LLMConfigError`; an unrelated 400 is not retried.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] RED first: `test_sampling_opt_in.py` fails on origin/main because `inferenceConfig` carries `temperature` for `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5`, `us.openai.gpt-5.5`, `us.moonshotai.kimi-k3.1` (output recorded in a ticket comment), then passes after the fix.
- [ ] For every rejecting/unknown id in Testing, the converse request has no `temperature`, `topP` or `topK` (asserted by the parametrized test).
- [ ] Each measured-accepting id still sends `temperature: 0.0` (parametrized positive control).
- [ ] Both rejection message forms (Claude "deprecated", OpenAI/Kimi "doesn't support … topP") are translated to `LLMConfigError` and trigger exactly one retry without sampling, remembered for that model; an unrelated 400 is neither translated nor retried (unit tests).
- [ ] `env -u JIRA_URL -u JIRA_USER -u JIRA_API_TOKEN make verify` passes; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` and `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` exit 0.
- [ ] Live Bedrock probe (us-west-2) of the fixed runner request for `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5`, `us.openai.gpt-5.5` and `us.moonshotai.kimi-k3.1` returns a response (no 400); results posted as a ticket comment.
